description: Land held collectively/legally by a trust rather than an individual owner, often with the goal of permanent protection

A residential community organized around shared values, goals, ownership, labor, or decision-making. Merged from two originally separate categories (Intentional Community, Cooperative/Collective) since in practice the distinction between organizing around shared values versus shared ownership/labor did not hold up consistently across how listings described themselves.
Land owned and hosted by one person or family, sometimes open to visitors/guests
Land used primarily for gatherings, retreats, or events rather than year-round residency
Group organizing or fundraising to acquire land, not yet an established community
